data.one_liner: Provides a unique device identifier across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Fetches a unique device identifier string using native platform APIs on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux, and localStorage or fingerprinting on the Web. It provides a consistent static method interface across all supported platforms.
use_when: You need a unique hardware or installation identifier for analytics or device tracking.
You are targeting multiple platforms including desktop, mobile, and web with a single API.
avoid_when: You require an identifier that strictly survives app uninstalls on iOS and Android.
You need secure unique IDs that cannot be reset or modified via local storage or browser settings on the web.
strengths: Supports all major platforms: Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web.
No external dependencies required beyond Flutter.
Clean static method interface for easy calling.
weaknesses: UUID may change after uninstalling and reinstalling the app on iOS and Android.
Web implementation relies on localStorage which can be cleared by the user.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and call the static method asynchronously.
